| `cars_allowed`          | number or null | optional               | Minimum: `0`. Maximum: `2`.           |
| `safe_duration_factor`  | number or null | optional               | —                                     |
| `safe_duration_offset`  | number or null | optional               | —                                     |

Returned without `select()`: `source_id`, `route_id`, `service_id`, `trip_id`, `trip_headsign`, `trip_short_name`, `direction_id`, `block_id`, `shape_id`, `wheelchair_accessible`, `bikes_allowed`, `cars_allowed`, `safe_duration_factor`, `safe_duration_offset`.

### References

References are checked within the same source. A match in any applicable target is sufficient; a condition limits which targets apply. These are not database foreign keys.

| Field        | Target file and field               | Applies when |
| ------------ | ----------------------------------- | ------------ |
| `route_id`   | `routes.txt` → `route_id`           | always       |
| `service_id` | `calendar.txt` → `service_id`       | always       |
| `service_id` | `calendar_dates.txt` → `service_id` | always       |
| `shape_id`   | `shapes.txt` → `shape_id`           | always       |

### Query filters

Use these with the [equality and semantic filter syntax](../query-filters.md).

- `serviceDate`: service date (YYYYMMDD).
